## 07 – Recovery Check (owner: Tharindu)
Wait `RECOVERY_WAIT_SECONDS` → query Prometheus (`up` + error rate) → repeat up to `RECOVERY_MAX_CHECKS` → verdict **recovered / not_recovered / unable_to_verify** → store via `POST /api/machine/recovery-checks` (**contract path, not implemented: BD-3**) → 08 Postmortem when recovered.

nodes.name: When called by 06 Remediation
nodes.notes: Input: { incident_id, playbook_run_id, service_name, action_type, simulated }

nodes.name: Verdict reached?
nodes.notes: false → wait and check again (max RECOVERY_MAX_CHECKS).

nodes.name: Return recovery result
nodes.notes: Always returns the recovery result (plus the postmortem status).
